editorial:
Imagine meeting someone at a loud party who actually gets you, and suddenly your whole world shifts. That is exactly what happens to Dave and Aubrey. They are two high schoolers from different schools who hit it off instantly. You will love how the movie captures those awkward, exciting early days of dating where every text message feels like a huge deal. It is a sweet, grounded story that feels like a warm hug rather than a cheesy fairy tale. The vibe is very relaxed and relatable, making you feel like you are right there with them as they navigate their first real relationship.

What really makes this work is the natural chemistry between the lead actors; they do not feel like movie stars, but like real kids. While the plot is pretty simple and does not have any wild twists, the slow pace helps you care about the couple. If you enjoy cute rom-coms, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture quality, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video. It is the perfect pick for a lazy Sunday afternoon.
endingExplained: After a few misunderstandings and the typical stress of being a teenager, Dave and Aubrey realize they truly care for each other. They move past their insecurities and decide to commit to the relationship. The movie wraps up on a hopeful note, showing that their first love was not just a fluke. They end up together, proving that the spark they felt at that first party was the real deal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sweet high school romance stories.
